messages.content: You are planning a sequence of ordinary, mundane public social-media posts for one fictional author. You do not write the posts; you invent the concrete, small, specific everyday occasions behind them. Output strict JSON only.

Author profile:
- płeć gramatyczna: mężczyzna (formy męskie)
- zajęcie i rytm dnia: Obsługuje sortownię odpadów na popołudniowej zmianie; pisze przed południem.
- zainteresowania: darty, naprawa lamp, kanapki na ciepło
- lokalny punkt odniesienia: plac przy ulicy Kolejowej w Żyrardowie
- aktualna sytuacja życiowa: Składa używane biurko i przestawia meble, żeby wygospodarować kąt do majsterkowania.
- sposób pisania: zdania: short fragments; interpunkcja: sparse, no commas; wielkie litery: all lowercase; literówki: frequent (missing diacritics, swapped letters); skróty: heavy; emoji: no
- tik językowy: kończy wpisy „i git”

For each of the 15 topic prompts below, invent ONE concrete, specific, small occasion from this person's life that would make them post (not a generic statement about the topic: a particular thing that happened, with at most one small detail a real person would mention - sometimes a product name, sometimes a number or price, sometimes a place, occasionally a time; many occasions need no such detail at all). Vary mood (bored, amused, tired, pleased, mildly annoyed, neutral, curious), vary how the post starts (mid-thought, a question, a one-word reaction, a fact, a quote of what someone said), and decide whether the verbal tic appears (at most in a third of posts). Occasions must not involve conflict with identifiable people, politics, crime, security, violence, or protected characteristics.

Topic prompts:
1. jedzenie i gotowanie - śniadanie w biegu (late morning, Thursday)
2. gry i seriale - nowy sezon serialu, bez spoilerów (lunch break, Wednesday)
3. zakupy i ceny - zakupy na targu (lunch break, Saturday)
4. komunikacja i dojazdy - parking, brak miejsc (evening, Thursday)
5. komunikacja i dojazdy - hulajnoga / scooter na minuty (afternoon, Monday)
6. sport - siłownia, nowy rekord (lunch break, Monday)
7. jedzenie i gotowanie - nowy przepis, eksperyment (evening, Sunday)
8. komunikacja i dojazdy - remont drogi na trasie (evening, Saturday)
9. sport - kontuzja, lekka, powrót do treningu (late night, Tuesday)
10. praca i grafik - praca zdalna, domowe biuro (lunch break, Saturday)
11. praca i grafik - wypłata, premia, rozliczenie (morning commute, Thursday)
12. remont i dom - meble do złożenia (afternoon, Friday)
13. zakupy i ceny - paczkomat, odbiór (late night, Sunday)
14. remont i dom - szukanie fachowca (lunch break, Monday)
15. technologia i sprzęt - problem z wifi (evening, Wednesday)

Return a JSON array of 15 objects, in order, each with:
- "occasion": one or two sentences in Polish, concrete
- "mood": one word in English
- "opener": one of "mid-thought", "question", "one-word reaction", "plain fact", "reported speech", "complaint", "list of two things"
- "length_words": integer between 8 and 50, varied across the set (some very short)
- "tic_fires": true or false
